description: This file defines the ComboKernel class for fusing multiple Triton kernels into a single efficient kernel. It includes methods for partitioning nodes, generating kernel code with heuristics, autotuning support, and benchmarking routines. The implementation relies on Triton, PyTorch, and project-specific utilities, indicating it is part of the PyTorch Inductor code generation system for optimizing GPU kernel fusion.

classes.name: ComboKernel
classes.description: A kernel class responsible for fusing multiple sub-kernels to optimize GPU computation. It manages node partitioning, heuristic selection, kernel code generation, benchmarking, and autotuning related tasks.

methods.description: Updates the current partition state, creating a new partition if the maximum number of arguments would be exceeded.
